name: sc-1775
title: The Carolinas, 1775-1781: reconstructed base map (WarMapper)
note: A WarMapper reconstruction, not a period map: the main lines of Mouzon's map of 1775, fitted to the ground; South Carolina since 25 Nov 2026, North Carolina to 77 W since 27 Nov 2026. See pipeline/recon/sc_1775.py. [longitude, latitude], WGS 84.

properties.name: Cherokee boundary line (1766)
properties.basis: Mouzon's line (Mouzon 1775 (S135), Library of Congress g3900.ar139404), picked by hand; the North Carolina lines were fitted to today's state line, which follows them (Natural Earth, S136). Mouzon draws it from the Savannah at a corner tree, past DeWitt's Corner, to a corner tree on the Reedy River and north to the 1772 line. The Cherokee ceded the land east of it in 1766-67 and nearly all the rest in South Carolina at DeWitt's Corner, 20 May 1777, so it is drawn until then.

properties.name: Catawba River
properties.basis: Picked by hand along Mouzon's river on the scan (Mouzon 1775 (S135), Library of Congress g3900.ar139404; the North Carolina part checked against Collet 1770 (S151, g3900.ar150000)) and snapped by program to the engraved line. This river lies a median 0.3-0.75 km from today's course in Natural Earth. It carries on the South Carolina line of the same river from the point where that line ends.
